description.en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must specify one and only one, and neither can be empty or both passed through simultaneously.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).

description.zh:
* 本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可。
description.en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must specify one and only one, and neither can be empty or both passed through simultaneously.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When using an HTTP request, upload the binary image file in the HTTP body.  
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK's body.

descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云火车票识别，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品，适用于识别火车票上车次、座位号、旅客信息、座位类型、票价等关键信息的场景。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |图片格式|支持PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP、OFD、PDF。| |图像增强|默认支持图像增强，包括图像自动旋转、畸变自动矫正、模糊图片自动增强等能力。| |多类型覆盖|支持模糊、光照不均、透视畸变、任意背景等低质量图像识别。| |高精度识别|总体识别准确率可达98%。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [票据凭证识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=bill&subtype=train_ticket#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买[火车票识别资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_invoice_dp_cn_20211103182712_0135%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。您也可以不购买资源包，系统会通过“[按量付费](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html)”方式按实际调用量自动扣款。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeTrainInvoice?sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| ------ #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP、OFD、PDF格式。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
  • 图片尺寸过小，会影响识别精度。图片内单字大小在10-50px内时，识别效果较好。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
| |相关能力|
  • [云市场火车票识别。](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi020096.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6dcb4dcdaoX2WN&innerSource=search#sku=yuncode1409600000)

descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud Train Ticket Recognition is an official self-developed OCR product from Alibaba Cloud, suitable for scenarios that require extracting key information from train tickets, such as train number, seat number, passenger details, seat class, and ticket price. * Based on DAMO Academy's advanced AI technologies and massive datasets, Alibaba Cloud's OCR products have been refined over years of development and offer several advantages: stable service, ease of use, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Category | Overview | |---|---------| | Image format | Supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, WebP, OFD, and PDF. | | Image enhancement | Enables image enhancement by default, including automatic rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Coverage of multiple types | Supports recognition of low-quality images, including blurry images, uneven lighting, perspective distortion, and arbitrary backgrounds. | | High-accuracy recognition | Achieves an overall recognition accuracy rate of up to 98%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Bill and Voucher Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can experience this feature for free via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=bill&subtype=train_ticket#intro). | | 2 | Purchase a [Train Ticket Recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_invoice_dp_cn_20211103182712_0135%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API provides a free quota for testing purposes. Alternatively, you may choose not to purchase a resource plan; the system will automatically deduct fees based on actual usage through the [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html) billing method. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeTrainInvoice?sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the Resource Access Management (RAM) user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM user](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For detailed steps on granting permissions, see [Grant permissions to a RAM user on the Users page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | ------ #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image format |
  • This API supports the following formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, WebP, OFD, and PDF.
| | Image dimensions |
  • Both height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (height-to-width or width-to-height) must be less than 50.
  • For optimal recognition results, we recommend that both height and width exceed 500 pixels.
  • Images that are too small may reduce recognition accuracy. Best results are achieved when individual characters in the image are between 10 and 50 pixels in size.
| | Image file size |
  • The binary file of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Excessively large images may slow down API response time. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Related capabilities |
  • [Train Ticket Recognition on Alibaba Cloud Marketplace](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi020096.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6dcb4dcdaoX2WN&innerSource=search#sku=yuncode1409600000).
|
